name: Onee-chan to Shota-kun to. ~Naka o Yoku Suru H no Kankei~
original_name: お姉ちゃんとショータくんと。 ～ナカを良くするHのカンケイ～
source: Shouta really loves his older sister and wants to take back their once good relationship, but she acts cold towards him. One day their father had to go on a business trip for several days, and Azusa invited her two female friends to stay at her place. But it seems her friends had something planned for her...
translation: 翔太非常喜欢姐姐，希望找回两人曾经亲密的关系，但姐姐对他态度冷淡。某天，父亲要出差几天，梓邀请两名女性朋友到家里留宿。然而，她的朋友们似乎另有打算……
